approvals.name: edit_image

args.name: Fox Mascot — Bike in the Park

style.prompt: Create one square flat cartoon illustration using the attached image as the exact character and style reference. Show this same friendly fox mascot riding a bicycle along a path in a green park, paws on handlebars and feet on pedals. Preserve its orange fur, cream muzzle and inner ears, golden cheek patches, black ear outlines, small black oval eyes and nose, cream-tipped bushy orange tail, orange pullover hoodie with drawstrings and kangaroo pocket, blue trousers, black paws and black shoes. Keep the same recognizable face and proportions. Match the original simple flat solid colors, thick clean black outlines, minimal shading, cheerful uncluttered vector-cartoon appearance. Include simple grass, rounded trees and a park path. Full mascot and bicycle visible, centered with comfortable margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, or watermarks.
